sections.what: Builds the main Intelligence hub: a hero with either the animation or a refinery photo, a headline and a jump link. Then one card per tool with its photo, name, promise, and extra links for guide, watch, demo or workspace.

summary: Shows the Intelligence hub page: a hero, a card for each of the four tools, and a closing note.
purpose: Lets a visitor pick one of the four intelligence tools.
why: Likely reason: a single starting page that sends people to the right tool.
how: Checks dark mode to pick the hero visual. Shows the headline and a jump link. Lists one card per tool with its photo, name, promise, and extra links such as the guide, watch, demo or workspace. Then adds a closing note and the shared footer.
inputs: The tool list from the content file and the dark mode setting.
outputs: The hub page shown in the browser. No data is saved.
risks: The hero photo uses a fixed file path, so renaming it breaks the picture. The footer is shared with the landing page, so changes there affect this page too.
debug: If a card is missing, check the tool list in the content file. If the hero picture is broken, check its path. If the footer looks wrong, check the shared footer in ToolLanding.
